news.headline: Datadog Soars 4% as Oppenheimer Lifts Price Target to $330 Ahead of Nov. 4 Earnings
news.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog shares rose 4% today after Oppenheimer raised its price target to $330 from $300 and kept its Outperform rating. This is the third target raise in a week, after Bernstein’s upgrade and BofA’s $335, and the consensus target has climbed from $169 to $293 over the past year.
